nonClaims: This pack does not provide a real postcode lookup.
This pack does not infer an Albanian national postcode pattern from scattered examples or administrative sources.

This pack does not download, store, or redistribute postcode mappings, ASIG administrative boundaries, INSTAT classification values, addresses, offices, contacts, properties, parcels, or location records.
This pack does not assert a household, building, street, point, or address-to-postcode match.
This pack does not assert delivery-point or carrier deliverability coverage.
